scope.additionalSharedEffects: Charge-bed and Siemens keys affect existing survey placements; mobile convergence CSS affects all branch figures. Geometry validation covers all 352 figures in both themes and widths.
scope.captured: 21 figures × 2 widths × 2 themes, before and after. Manual review concentrated on desktop-light and phone-dark; opposite themes received automated geometry checks rather than a separate exhaustive semantic rereview.
scope.limitations: Comparison glyphs remain simplified teaching symbols. This is a fresh full-size/source review of the selected 21 figures, not a claim of reviewing the remaining deep modules or re-verifying all numerical facts. Existing course fact-review uncertainties remain.

verification.result: Final rebuilt source passes npm run check (352/352 authored figures, 32/32 source prose and heading preservation) and 352 figures at two widths and two themes with zero geometry errors. Final polishing-pad contact correction visually reviewed at phone-dark.
